goal: A real local interactive Linux shell with a user file surviving orderly stop and a fresh app process, separate from the existing accepted probe.

approved_architecture.shell: Existing guest BusyBox 1.37.0 ash with a real controlling TTY established by getty/ttyAMA0, TERM=dumb. Local interactive line console with basic control keys, not full VT/full-screen terminal emulation.
approved_architecture.transport: Two local AF_UNIX socket pairs: bidirectional terminal and independent virtio control. No networking/listening service added.
approved_architecture.storage_seed: Separate deterministic preformatted FAT16 128 MiB seed; copy once to Documents/iDeckLinux/userdata.raw.
approved_architecture.guest_mount: /data is the only persistent guest location; initramfs/root remains volatile.
approved_architecture.reuse_rule: Verify bundled resources independently, copy seed only when userdata is absent; never format an existing disk or reset after a mount error, and never require modified userdata to equal the empty seed hash.
approved_architecture.storage_limit: FAT16 does not provide full POSIX permissions, symlinks or a persistent Linux rootfs; survival across uninstall/reset or unclean termination is not promised.
approved_architecture.stop_protocol: Fixed IDECK_STOP_V1 on org.ideck.control independent virtio port reaches PID1. Stop children, sync/unmount/poweroff; host requires IDECK_TERMINAL_CLEAN_UNMOUNT, QEMU loop return and userdata fsync before terminal_clean_stopped.
approved_architecture.lifecycle: One VM per app process. Choose probe or terminal before start; after stop fully close/reopen into a fresh process. Disk lock retained until app exit even after orderly stop; no in-process restart or full QEMU teardown/drain claim.
approved_architecture.preservation: Original probe assets/archive/guest lock, native pins and existing JIT/Markdown functionality remain protected.

dependency_review.source: Documentation agent read the locked original guest archive in memory without extraction, installation or execution; future interactive guest runtime tests are pending.

dependency_review.source_availability_limit: Coordinator reports source fetch access denial (403); exact correspondence/source-package and musl license audit is incomplete. Official musl site could not be fetched by this documentation agent. No access bypass attempted.
dependency_review.legal_scope: Dependency/provenance observations, not license-compliance certification. Preserve upstream notices and record source acquisition gaps in the new guest NOTICE; no new terminal library or network package assumed.
dependency_review.builtin_verification_source: Read exact usr/lib/modules/6.18.35-0-virt/modules.builtin from original locked initramfs; distinct from filesystem/block loadable modules.

implementation.probe_preservation: Build verifies original archive/files, appends a deterministic independent compressed CPIO containing two new rdinit/login scripts to the original probe initramfs bytes; original three probe resources remain untouched.
implementation.kernel: Reuse original verified vmlinuz-virt through LinuxGuestProfile; terminal profile cannot choose another kernel.
implementation.disk_handling: New copied-once userdata.raw is checked as a bounded regular non-symlink file and retained with an independent exclusive lock. Existing contents are reused instead of re-seeded; only a failure before entering QEMU releases ownership early. Once QEMU is entered, retain disk ownership until process exit even after guest CLEAN, main-loop return and host fsync.
implementation.qemu_transport: Two already-connected AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM socket pairs handed to QEMU chardev fd with server=off; original -nic none retained. Console uses ttyAMA0; independent virtio serial port is org.ideck.control.
implementation.stop: PID1 handles fixed control STOP even while a shell foreground child runs, kills writers, syncs, unmounts /data, syncs again, acknowledges clean unmount then powers off. Host finalizes only after acknowledgement plus QEMU return and disk fsync.
implementation.ui: Probe/terminal chosen before any VM starts; local line entry plus Send/Ctrl-C/Ctrl-D/Tab/Esc and Stop Linux; original JIT setup and Markdown/raw sharing retained.
implementation.failure_truth: Channel loss, timeout, missing clean ack, failed unmount/fsync or mere VM return is not a clean-stop pass; no destructive mount-failure disk reset.
implementation.control_isolation: Guest getty/shell closes inherited fd3. Readiness and clean-unmount acknowledgements are accepted only from the independent supervisor control port, not console text.
implementation.timeouts: Startup 60 seconds and Stop 30 seconds record/report failure without force shutdown or clean PASS. Guest STOP_FAILED is sticky; serial EOF does not disable the independent Stop control.
implementation.elapsed_scope: Whole terminal worker session including disk preparation, initialization, interactive use and Stop; not pure boot time or the original probe post-init polling interval.
